title: Peak emf calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the peak induced emf using the formula E_m = N B S ω, yielding 50 V.

title: Instantaneous emf expression
description: Essential: The student must provide the correct instantaneous expression e = 50 cos(10πt) V, including the correct argument for the cosine function.

title: Circuit current effective value
description: Essential: The student must calculate the ammeter reading (effective current) as I = E_m / [√2 (R+r)], yielding approximately 1.41 A.

title: Application of Ohm's Law
description: Important: The student must correctly apply Ohm's Law to the total circuit resistance (R + r) when finding the current.

title: Cosine function argument
description: Important: The student must correctly identify that the emf is a cosine function of ωt, given the coil starts parallel to the field.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The student's work should demonstrate consistent use of SI units throughout the calculation.

title: Incorrect trigonometric function
description: Pitfall: Using sine instead of cosine for the instantaneous emf expression, given the stated initial condition.

title: Resistance omission error
description: Pitfall: Forgetting to include the coil's internal resistance 'r' when calculating the total circuit resistance for the current.
